## Design

### 2026-10-05 – I spent half an hour reading the starbie guide and from there I thought to make the whole starbie thing into a pcb shaped the like head of Rick from Rick and Morty (I’ve included a reference image)

**0.5h**

I spent half an hour reading the starbie guide and from there I thought to make the whole starbie thing into a pcb shaped the like head of Rick from Rick and Morty (I’ve included a reference image)

![IMG_1965](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/qzp65iht2C9gLUjk7Hp1vSSCQbdDZClV/2bb5e2c791339c81986b430cb56528cea52bd65c87f79263b2759732483f71c8.jpeg)

. As you can see I have sketched a layout of the pcb including all the components, but also included some sprite concept for the actual “pet” part that displays on the oled screen, I think I’m going to go with the eye because that one makes the most sense though

![IMG_1964](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/qzp65iht2C9gLUjk7Hp1vSSCQbdDZClV/bd91fdbabea64e1baab19adbe44441ac602a63bbb3a0bb4e07a2f2103086450c.jpeg)

### 2026-10-08 – I started working on the starburst pcb, which I will later rearrange into ricks head, this is one of my first times using Kicad and it took me a little while to finish the schematic. When I was done I

**1h**

I started working on the starburst pcb, which I will later rearrange into ricks head, this is one of my first times using Kicad and it took me a little while to finish the schematic. When I was done I imported the footprints from the care package and started adding footprints to the schematic. As you can see in the photos that did not go well, I picked a lot of the wrong footprints and the pcb is looking weird so I stopped and that’s it.

![IMG_1968](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/qzp65iht2C9gLUjk7Hp1vSSCQbdDZClV/7842f2709af7ea0bf7e16a18a26c57e89c83b93e3060577475d47af5af4498c3.png)

![IMG_1967](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/qzp65iht2C9gLUjk7Hp1vSSCQbdDZClV/141c60c5ab3242f08fb174f01369e1fd13030d41734e095bcebeb7faa22f2db0.png)

### 2026-10-08 – ![Screenshot 2026-10-08 205415](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/qzp65iht2C9gLUjk7Hp1vSSCQbdDZClV/0c0b057e5659a045ad3a29f73cc600c356666bce8a955e43709ca0eeefbcf0e3.png)

**2.5h**

![Screenshot 2026-10-08 205415](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/qzp65iht2C9gLUjk7Hp1vSSCQbdDZClV/0c0b057e5659a045ad3a29f73cc600c356666bce8a955e43709ca0eeefbcf0e3.png)

![Screenshot 2026-10-08 205402](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/qzp65iht2C9gLUjk7Hp1vSSCQbdDZClV/d44f41d47e193e5dceffc2bead077492411ae712f72426ee3e4026b95eef6501.png)

I fixed all of the footprints to be correct, and then I tried importing a screenshot as a little image on the board, I converted it to .bmp and tried using the converted but it was a color image and didn't work, I tried for a while but it didn't work it just imported as a blob, so I gave up. I Then added some edge cuts to make the PCB in the shape of rick's head. Then I started drawing out the wires but that got messy fast so I added a 3.3v layer and a gnd layer after fiddling around with fills for a while. Then I actually wired all of the things together. After that I added some silk layer lines to make it look a bit better, some to outline his head and some to make a little mouth and nose, I uploaded the reference picture I used for his mouth. Then I ran the DRC and it gave me an error saying I had a malformed outline, so I tried to fix that but it just wouldn't work so I gave up for the night.

![Screenshot 2026-10-08 9.18.04 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/qzp65iht2C9gLUjk7Hp1vSSCQbdDZClV/086bca38994697496276a65faf37b70db90752cd6ad6b8c006344f91849c9020.png)

### 2026-10-11 – In this section I tried fixing the malformed shape error but couldn't there seems to be some sort of microscopic spec on the edge cut so I just let it be. Then I made a GitHub repo for all of the stuf

**2h**

In this section I tried fixing the malformed shape error but couldn't there seems to be some sort of microscopic spec on the edge cut so I just let it be. Then I made a GitHub repo for all of the stuff and tried setting up the kicad on GitHub which took a little while. Once the repo was set up I added the starbie's Arduino skectch and did some costomization to the menus and stuff. I also drew a little pixel art Rick to be the pet and I added that as the sprite, you can see the image of the sprite and the sprite's array in the sketch. After that I exported the gerber files and added those to the repo and thats it.
